assumptions: Each row identifies one configuration and request rate in the admission grid.
Each sample is a mean response time within one simulation window, expressed in seconds.
The 256- and 512-window arrays are exact prefixes of the 1024-window array for the same row.
The simulation source retains the 1024 window means, measured request counts, row seeds and parameters.
P95 and P99 are computed across each row with linear quantile interpolation.
The nominal column is an analytical response prediction, not the empirical sample mean.
L_s/C2 describe service times and are not the mean/variance of these window-response samples.

simulation_protocol.service_distribution: Gamma with mean L_s and squared coefficient of variation C2
